data.body: **P3 — Pin the old-core compatibility path.** Excluding the workspace prevents use of the local core, but the existing `>=2.0.0` dependency still resolves the latest PyPI release. Once a core containing `handler_context` is published, this suite takes the new-core branch and no longer verifies compatibility with supported older cores. Pin this environment to the minimum supported core, or add a version matrix that explicitly exercises legacy releases.
